title: Cold email for a proof-free clinic pilot
scenario:
TOPIC: Write a concise cold email for a clinic no-show pilot
Write a cold email to the owner of a two-doctor dental clinic whose receptionist manually confirms appointments by phone. The founder offers automated reminders set up in seven days for ₹6,000 per month. There are no customers, testimonials, or measured results yet. The email must use a short subject line, make only one low-friction ask, replace absent proof with a meaningful risk reversal, and include an A/B subject variant. Also state the persona, full offer, why the copy works, and objections handled. Do not invent performance statistics.
improvement_suggestions: Open with the receptionist's daily frustration rather than product features.
Ask the reader to take only one easy next action.
Use a founder-funded trial in place of unsupported social proof.
